summary: Prove numerical correctness and complete admitted execution existence for the 256-lane shared reduction tree.

examined.reason: Complete the shared-tree milestone: actual publication values, arbitrary-input complete candidate construction, proved byte-source admission and universal memory bounds. The universal theorem retains arbitrary admitted interleavings and all permitted NaN encodings; the constructor chooses one finite schedule and canonical arithmetic results only for existence.
Promote the shared-tree numerical and existence result while retaining full emitted entry, native control, input/output and solver composition as explicit remaining obligations.
The reference solver, discrete equations, numerical reduction specification, emitted kernels and independent residual certificate are unchanged.

No primitive semantics or source-admission rules changed. Chronological coherence is an explicit existence witness, not a restriction on the universal theorem. Mathematical execution existence is not arbitrary-scheduler progress or GPU conformance. The existing combined lane guard remains separate from native predicate/branch refinement.

results.method: Fourteen sequential capped Lean module checks; exact full declaration dependency audit; dependency/source guards; saved PTX binding refresh; manual theorem/assumption/scope review; receipt hashes, Stratic links and identical final snapshots.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and 16 dependency pins. Heavy checks use hard 6 GiB cgroups, no swap and 150 percent CPU quota; new proofs and full audit use one Lean thread. No GPU execution or paid model calls.
results.evidence: 4907 exact dependency reports with only standard Lean axioms; 589 guarded source files. All 14 new modules compile with no warnings. Actual register analysis and preceding-store selection prove every publication follows the exact eight-round binary64 tree; completed admitted runs contain the correct actual final store. Separate symbolic construction handles arbitrary initial words, active/inactive lane bodies and all nine full-block barriers, proves valid accesses, and constructs compatible byte sources plus necessary repeated-write admission from real producers. The existence theorem takes no execution, desired read value, publication table or source witness as a premise. A separate universal theorem bounds every access within the original aligned 2048-byte shared region. The cancellation instantiation constructs a completed admitted execution returning decoded two, preserving its distinction from the existing sequential-fold result one. No finiteness restriction on input words or canonical-output restriction on the universal theorem. Primitive semantics, previous theorem premises, emitted PTX, numerical reference and README unchanged. Full native predicate/branch translation, input accumulation, global-output epilogue, solver composition and hardware/full PTX admission remain separate. Saved bindings refreshed for 720 contractions, 630 stores, 30 residual layouts and 1440 reduction updates. Source-identical legacy targets reused after hash verification; actual binding/dependency audits reran. Full legacy build/interpreter suite not repeated. Receipt hashes match current sources; Stratic validates, whitespace check passes and final snapshots agree.
